market.headline: Seaport Global Initiates Coverage on General Motors with Buy Rating
market.summary: Seaport Global analyst Ron Jewsikow has initiated coverage on General Motors with a Buy rating and a price target of $106.

market.headline: The Charles Schwab Corporation Files for Mixed Shelf Offering
market.summary: The Charles Schwab Corporation has filed a registration statement with the SEC for a mixed shelf offering, though the specific size of the offering was not disclosed.

market.headline: Canada Life Investment Management Ltd. Appoints JPMorgan Asset Management as Sub-Advisor
market.summary: Canada Life Investment Management Ltd., a subsidiary of Great-West Lifeco Inc., has appointed JPMorgan Asset Management (Canada) Inc. as a sub-advisor for several investment portfolios.

market.headline: Alberta Bill Poses Potential Risk to TC Energy Growth Plans, CIBC Analysts Say
market.summary: CIBC analysts have identified a new Alberta legislative bill as a potential risk factor for TC Energy's future growth initiatives.

market.headline: S&P Global Ratings Places NVIDIA on CreditWatch Negative
market.summary: S&P Global Ratings has placed NVIDIA's AA credit ratings on CreditWatch Negative, citing concerns regarding management and governance risks.

market.headline: CIBC Mellon Expands Data Capabilities with Snowflake
market.summary: CIBC Mellon, a joint venture of CIBC and BNY, is integrating Snowflake's AI data cloud to enhance its data management and analytics capabilities.

market.headline: Allstate Suffers Multi-day Tech Outage Ahead of Thanksgiving
market.summary: The Allstate Corporation is experiencing a multi-day technology outage affecting its systems leading into the Thanksgiving holiday.

market.headline: Brookfield Property Partners Declares Quarterly Dividends on Listed Preferred Units
market.summary: Brookfield Property Partners, a subsidiary of Brookfield Corporation, has declared quarterly cash distributions for its series of Class A preferred units.

market.headline: Puerto Rico Supreme Court Rules to Cancel Luma Energy Contract
market.summary: The Puerto Rico Supreme Court has ruled in favor of canceling the government's contract with Luma Energy, a consortium that includes Quanta Services.

market.headline: Kehewin Cree Nation Opposes Pathways CO₂ Transportation Network and Storage Hub Project
market.summary: The Kehewin Cree Nation has formally notified Suncor Energy and four other project proponents of its opposition to the Pathways CO₂ Transportation Network and Storage Hub Project, citing significant human safety and environmental concerns.

market.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Launch of Leveraged ETF Tracking Valero Energy
market.summary: Tradr ETFs has announced the upcoming launch of the Tradr 2X Long VLO Daily ETF (Cboe: VLOX), a new leveraged financial product designed to track the daily performance of Valero Energy Corporation.

market.headline: Analysts Update Ratings and Price Targets for Snowflake
market.summary: Several financial analysts updated their ratings and price targets for Snowflake on November 25, 2026.

market.headline: eBay CEO Discusses Normalization of Pre-Owned Merchandise
market.summary: eBay CEO Jamie Iannone stated that the stigma surrounding pre-owned goods has dissipated, noting that consumers increasingly view buying pre-loved items as a normal and valuable shopping behavior.

market.headline: Cloud Maven, Inc. Launches LightningDocs Connector for Salesforce
market.summary: Cloud Maven, Inc. has introduced a new connector that allows real estate and private lenders to prepare loan documents directly within Salesforce workflows.

market.headline: Doba Launches Seller Recruitment Campaign for Walmart Marketplace
market.summary: Doba, an approved Walmart Solution Provider, has initiated a campaign to recruit online retailers to sell on the Walmart Marketplace.

market.headline: Kirby McInerney LLP Investigates UnitedHealth Group Inc. Following Medicare Advantage Audit Rule Proposal
market.summary: The law firm of Kirby McInerney LLP has announced an investigation into UnitedHealth Group regarding potential violations of federal securities laws following a decline in the company's share price.

market.headline: Analyst Actions: BNP Paribas and AlphaValue/Baader Europe Update DHL Group Ratings
market.summary: Financial analysts at BNP Paribas and AlphaValue/Baader Europe have issued updated research notes regarding DHL Group, adjusting their price targets and ratings for the company.

market.headline: Glencore Appoints New Lead for Coal Division
market.summary: Glencore has appointed the nephew of its former CEO to lead its coal business unit.

market.headline: Grupo Financiero Galicia Reports Q3 2026 Earnings Miss
market.summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results, missing earnings expectations due to margin compression in a lower-rate environment.

market.headline: Genetic Analysis AS Enters OEM Agreement with Merck
market.summary: Genetic Analysis AS has signed an OEM agreement with Merck to expand its presence in the global life science research market.

market.headline: Bradesco Principal Announces Black Friday Benefits for Cardholders
market.summary: Bradesco Principal and American Express are offering exclusive benefits and rewards for eligible cardholders as part of a Black Friday campaign at the Pátio Higienópolis shopping center.

market.headline: VINCI Concessions Becomes Majority Shareholder of LISEA
market.summary: VINCI Concessions has acquired an additional 8% stake in LISEA, the concessionaire for the South Europe Atlantic high-speed rail line, bringing its total ownership to 50.04%.

market.headline: Infineon Launches RASIC CTRX8144FS Radar MMIC for ADAS
market.summary: Infineon has introduced the RASIC CTRX8144FS, a 76-81 GHz radar MMIC designed to support centralized vehicle architectures and advanced driver assistance systems.

market.headline: Aboitiz Equity Ventures CFO Named ING-Finex CFO of the Year
market.summary: Jose Emmanuel “Toto” Hilado, CFO of Aboitiz Equity Ventures, has been awarded the ING-Finex CFO of the Year for his role in the company's financial and strategic transformation.

market.headline: Chubb Joins Intact as Principal Sponsor of BIBA 2027
market.summary: Chubb has been announced as a principal sponsor for the British Insurance Brokers' Association (BIBA) 2027 conference, partnering alongside Intact.

market.headline: Jefferies Adjusts XP Inc. Price Target to $18
market.summary: Analyst Diego Sarmento Pereira of Jefferies maintained a "Buy" rating on XP Inc. while lowering the price target from $22 to $18.

market.headline: Siemens Signs Strategic Data Centre Infrastructure Agreements in Qatar
market.summary: Siemens has entered into two memoranda of understanding (MoUs) with MEEZA and Sendian Group to explore collaborations on data centre infrastructure and digital solutions in Qatar.

market.headline: Equinor Revises 2026 Production Guidance Following Operational Challenges
market.summary: Equinor has lowered its 2026 production growth guidance to approximately 3% from a previously communicated 4% target, citing temporary shut-ins and operational issues at several fields.

market.headline: Citigroup Upgrades Adecoagro S.A. to Buy
market.summary: Citigroup has upgraded Adecoagro S.A. from Neutral to Buy, while setting a new price target of $9.75.

market.headline: Insider Transaction Filing: Alejandro Gustavo Elsztain
market.summary: Alejandro Gustavo Elsztain filed a Form 4 regarding holdings in BrasilAgro on November 24, 2026.

market.headline: UBS Adjusts Price Target on Inter & Co to $6.60
market.summary: UBS has revised its price target for Inter & Co, lowering it from $10.00 to $6.60 while maintaining a "Buy" rating on the stock.

market.headline: Globant Announces Converge 2026 Virtual Event
market.summary: Globant has announced its flagship virtual event, Converge 2026, scheduled for December 10, 2026, focusing on enterprise reinvention in the AI-Native Era.

market.headline: Foresea Recognized in Petrobras Offshore Drilling Rig Operational Excellence Awards
market.summary: Foresea has been ranked first in all four editions of the Petrobras Offshore Drilling Rig Operational Excellence Award (PEO-Sondas) and named Brazil's Best Offshore Drilling Contractor for 2025.

market.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Best Buy Price Target
market.summary: Morgan Stanley has updated its price target for Best Buy Co., Inc., moving it from $90 to $100.

market.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Dell Technologies Price Target
market.summary: Morgan Stanley has updated its price target for Dell Technologies Inc., moving it from $403 to $408.

market.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Western Digital Corporation
market.summary: Evercore ISI and BNP Paribas have revised their price targets for Western Digital Corporation amid broader semiconductor market volatility.

market.headline: Chinese Investor Signs Hotel Management Deals with Marriott International
market.summary: Marriott International has entered into new hotel management agreements with a Chinese investor, as reported in the context of tourism development in Uzbekistan.

market.headline: CIBC Analyst Adjusts Bank of Montreal Price Target
market.summary: CIBC analyst Paul Holden maintains a "hold" rating on Bank of Montreal while adjusting the target price to $178.31.

market.headline: J.B. Hunt Files Opposition to Proposed Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger
market.summary: Intermodal operator J.B. Hunt has formally requested that regulators deny the proposed merger between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern, citing concerns over competitive harm.

market.headline: Kehewin Cree Nation Opposes Pathways CO2 Project
market.summary: The Kehewin Cree Nation has formally notified ConocoPhillips Canada and other project proponents of its opposition to the Pathways CO2 Transportation Network and Storage Hub Project, citing concerns over human safety and environmental risks.

market.headline: Supreme Court of British Columbia Rules in Class Action Regarding Supplement Labeling
market.summary: The Supreme Court of British Columbia has issued a ruling in a national class action concerning the labeling of glucosamine sulfate supplements sold by various retailers, including Costco.

market.headline: Shell Announces Share Buyback Transactions
market.summary: Shell plc reported the purchase of shares for cancellation as part of its ongoing share buyback program.

market.headline: BlackRock, Inc. Discloses Change in Voting Rights in SAP SE
market.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported a change in its voting rights position in SAP SE, crossing a threshold as of November 20, 2026.

market.headline: Webull Canada Announces Integration Project with TradingView
market.summary: Webull Canada has initiated a project to integrate its platform with TradingView, aiming to enhance charting and technical analysis capabilities for its users.

market.headline: KeyBanc Adjusts Texas Pacific Land Price Target
market.summary: KeyBanc Capital Markets has revised its price target for Texas Pacific Land Corporation to $388 from $639.

market.headline: UBS Adjusts Mattel Price Target to $26
market.summary: UBS has lowered its price target for Mattel, Inc. from $28 to $26 while maintaining a Buy rating on the stock.

market.headline: Stifel Adjusts Price Target on Federal Realty Investment Trust to $118 From $120
market.summary: Stifel has revised its price target for Federal Realty Investment Trust, lowering it from $120 to $118.

market.headline: BofA Securities Adjusts Kohl's Price Target to $19
market.summary: BofA Securities has raised its price target for Kohl's Corporation from $16.00 to $19.00.

market.headline: Scotiabank Downgrades Zscaler to Sector Perform
market.summary: Scotiabank has downgraded Zscaler, Inc. from Sector Outperform to Sector Perform, setting a price target of $260.

market.headline: UBS Raises Kohl's Price Target to $13
market.summary: UBS has increased its price target for Kohl's Corporation shares from $9.00 to $13.00.

SNY.headline: RBC Capital Markets Upgrades Sanofi to Outperform
SNY.summary: RBC Capital Markets has upgraded Sanofi to Outperform and raised its price target, following similar positive actions from other financial institutions.

NTNX.headline: Oppenheimer, RBC, and BofA Securities Adjust Nutanix Ratings and Price Targets
NTNX.summary: Following Nutanix's recent earnings report and CEO succession announcement, multiple financial institutions including Oppenheimer, RBC, and BofA Securities have adjusted their price targets and ratings for the company.

NTNX.headline: Nutanix CEO Rajiv Ramaswami to Step Down
NTNX.summary: Nutanix, Inc. announced that CEO Rajiv Ramaswami will step down from his role once a successor is appointed.

NTNX.headline: BofA Securities Downgrades Nutanix to Neutral
NTNX.summary: BofA Securities has downgraded Nutanix, Inc. to a Neutral rating with a price target of $62.

DELL.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Dell Technologies
DELL.summary: Several financial institutions, including UBS, Deutsche Bank, and Morgan Stanley, updated their price targets for Dell Technologies on November 25, 2026.

MU.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Upcoming Launch of Leveraged ETF Featuring Micron Technology, Inc.
MU.summary: Tradr ETFs announced plans to launch the "Tradr Triple Threat 2X Long Memory Daily ETF" on December 2, 2026, which will provide leveraged exposure to Micron Technology, Inc. and other memory sector stocks.

SNDK.headline: SanDisk Chief Accounting Officer Discloses Stock Sale in SEC Filing
SNDK.summary: Michael Pokorny, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer of SanDisk, sold 26,016 shares of company stock in a transaction reported on November 25, 2026.

CRWV.headline: CoreWeave's Banks to Sell $4.5 Billion Loan Secured by GPUs for Meta
CRWV.summary: CoreWeave is reportedly working with banks to sell a $4.5 billion loan, with the debt facility secured by GPU infrastructure dedicated to Meta Platforms.

CRWV.headline: CoreWeave Credit Default Swap Spreads Reach Distressed Levels
CRWV.summary: CoreWeave's five-year credit default swap (CDS) spreads have widened to 1,314 basis points, signaling increased market concern regarding the company's credit risk.

NBIS.headline: Nebius Shares Decline Following HPE Financing Warning
NBIS.summary: Nebius Group shares experienced a decline following a reported financing warning related to Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE).

BE.headline: Bloom Energy Supports Nashville Students and Families
BE.summary: Bloom Energy partnered with Nashville firefighters to support local students and families ahead of the Tennessee-Vanderbilt football game.

AMAT.headline: UBS Adjusts Price Target on Applied Materials
AMAT.summary: UBS has revised its price target for Applied Materials, lowering it from $640 to $575 while maintaining a Buy rating.
